integrity: An exact algebraic proof accompanies reproducibility code. Finite-field enumerations are corroborating computations and not the proof. Publication, peer review and independent mathematical validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: No claim for higher-degree unitriangular groups or all class-three groups. The zero fiber is already implicit in published unitriangular branching counts, so claimed originality concerns the exact nonidentity fiber law. A broader preexisting fiber formula might have escaped the bibliographic search; the complete 2015 Nath--Yadav article was unavailable for comparison.
scope: Every prime-power field, the commutator word on UT_4 and the additive bracket on strictly upper triangular four-by-four matrices; every prescribed target in their three-dimensional derived spaces.
title: Exact commutator-fiber law for degree-four unitriangular groups
